shape: Square arena, NW corner collapsed (N+E gates)
description: Same square arena primitive as lb1 (two-gate, N + E, dispatch via center) but with the NW corner collapsed — there is no walkable floor in the negative-X / positive-Z quadrant of the room. The center anchor still handles dispatch; three corner anchors (NE, SE, SW) cover the remaining quadrants for objective discovery.

portals.north: spawn_north at (0.20, -23.71) — gate on the north (low-Z) side
portals.east: spawn_east at (23.42, 0.38) — gate on the east (high-X) side

traversalNotes: Direct N↔E route: spawn_north → arena_center → spawn_east (and reverse). Same L-through-center as lb1.

NW QUADRANT IS COLLAPSED: there is NO floor in the negative-X / positive-Z corner. The solver must not emit any anchor or edge that crosses that quadrant. If an objective appears in the NW region of the room, route the dispatch through arena_center and approach via an axis-aligned leg from either north_gate or east_gate's nearest edge — never directly across the missing corner.

DISPATCH RULE: any in-cell objective routes through arena_center → nearest corner_detour → objective → reverse. The three corner anchors form a fully-connected triangle so the autopilot can wrap around any corner-to-corner objective chain.
Square arena variant: lb1 had all four corners; lb3 drops the NW corner. The 'square arena, dispatch via center' primitive still applies — just with fewer corner anchors and a no-go zone.
